package_info.why_malicious: There is no evidence of malicious behavior. Jake is a legitimate open source tool for vulnerability scanning in Conda environments. The report and screenshots show only normal installation and usage patterns, with no indication of malicious code, suspicious network activity, or intent to harm. No malicious code or indicators are present in the report.

detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: There is no indication of malware or suspicious behavior in the provided report. Jake is a legitimate tool for checking known vulnerabilities in Conda environments. Standard monitoring for unexpected network requests, unauthorized file modifications, or privilege escalations is always recommended as a best practice, but nothing in this report suggests Jake is malicious or requires special detection rules.
